spellbook.finance/limitations: This is NOT a read. It flips the exported copies from owned to listed and writes listing records, before TCGplayer has seen anything.

So if the person never uploads the CSV, SpellBook believes copies are listed that TCGplayer has never heard of, and those copies then drop out of spellbook_ebay_publish, which takes owned copies only. Say this to the person in the same message as the file.
It cannot upload for them. TCGplayer has no seller publish API, so a person signs in to the TCGplayer portal and uploads the file by hand.
The CSV comes back split by finish when both are present, because the portal takes them separately.
It is not idempotent. A second call exports whatever is still owned and flips that too.

description: Produce the CSV a person uploads to the TCGplayer portal, and mark those copies as listed in SpellBook. Call it only after spellbook_tcg_listing_preview and only once the person has said they will upload the file. Hand them the CSV and tell them plainly that SpellBook now believes these copies are listed, so the upload has to happen.

floorPrice.description: Must match the value shown in spellbook_tcg_listing_preview to export the same priced candidates.

sampleSize.description: Must match the value shown in spellbook_tcg_listing_preview to export the same candidate set.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to export a TCGplayer upload CSV for. Required; writes listing records for this workspace.
